title: Making Friends as an Adult
paragraphs: After moving to a new city for work, Hafsa realized that making friends as an adult felt far harder than it had during university, when shared classes made new friendships almost automatic.
She decided to join a weekly community class at her local mosque, feeling nervous walking in alone for the first session, unsure whether anyone would be interested in getting to know her.
The first few weeks felt slow, with only brief, polite conversations before and after class, but by the second month, she was exchanging numbers with two women who shared similar interests.

A year later, those small connections had grown into a genuine friend group, and Hafsa realized that adult friendships simply required more deliberate effort than the ones she had taken for granted when younger.
